pool org "Organization"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start s "Switch-over request"
    task t1 "Transmit customer data"
    task t16 "Customer checks contract details"
    xor g5 "Customer withdraws?"
    task t17 "Withdraw from switch contract"
    task t26 "Receive final billing"
    end e_customer "Customer process ends"
    end e_withdraw "Process ends after withdrawal"

  lane customer_service "Customer Service"
    task t2 "Receive customer data"
    task t3 "Enter customer data into CRM"
    task t4 "Compare customer data with internal database and check completeness"
    xor g1 "Data errors?"
    task t5 "Correct errors based on error list"
    xor g2 "Customer exists?"
    task t6 "Create new customer object"
    task t7 "Prepare contract documents for power supplier switch"
    task t21 "Import meter data to systems"
    end e_cs_import "Customer Service process ends"

  lane cis "CIS"
    task t8 "Automated contract check"
    xor g3 "Contract check positive?"
    task t9 "Analyze and resolve contract issues"
    task t10 "Send confirmation document to customer"
    task t11 "Send request to Grid Operator"
    end e_cis "CIS process ends"

  lane grid_operator "Grid Operator"
    task t12 "Check supplier concurrence"
    xor g4 "Supplier concurrence?"
    task t13 "Inform all involved suppliers and demand resolution of conflict"
    task t14 "Communicate with old supplier and terminate sales agreement"
    task t15 "Create CIS contract"
    task t19 "Send meter data to Customer Service"
    task t22 "Compute final billing"
    task t23 "Send final billing to Old Supplier"
    and g6 "Parallel split for post‑acceptance activities"
    and g7 "Parallel join before final ends"
    end e_grid "Grid Operator process ends"

  lane old_supplier "Old Supplier"
    task t20 "Receive meter data"
    task t24 "Create final billing for customer"
    task t25 "Send final billing to customer"
    end e_old "Old Supplier process ends"

# Flows
flow s -> t1 -> t2 -> t3 -> t4 -> g1
flow g1 "yes" -> t5 -> t4
flow g1 "no" -> g2
flow g2 "yes" -> t7
flow g2 "no" -> t6 -> t7
flow t7 -> t8 -> g3

flow g6 -> t19 -> t21 -> g7
flow g6 -> t22 -> t23 -> t24 -> t25 -> t26 -> g7
flow g7 -> e_cs_import
